bonuses.name: Iron Soul
bonuses.text: This Follower is unaffected by abilities that target the mind, and never needs to make a Resolve test to continue fighting.

bonuses.name: Assistant
bonuses.text: While a Medicae Servitor is within 3m of its owner, its owner adds +2d to any Medicae test they attempt.

abilities.name: Pharmacopoeia
abilities.text: The Medicae Servitor may use any of the uses for the Medicae skill listed on p.124 of the Wrath & Glory Core Rulebook, and is considered to be carrying a Medikit.

abilities.name: Mindlock
abilities.text: The Servitor is Exhausted for 1 round. This can be negated by an ally succeeding on a DN 3 Tech (Int) Test.
